parties.respondent: Delhi Airport Metro Express Pvt. Ltd.

summary: Validity of termination notice under concession agreement; defects in civil structures allegedly impacting safety; termination valid due to uncured material defects; tribunal upheld termination entitling concessionaire to payment; high court partly set aside; supreme court restored arbitral award; curative petition challenged patent illegality; analysis of termination clause interpretation and evidence; inherent jurisdiction under Article 142 examined; no miscarriage of justice found.
final_judgment: Curative petition dismissed; arbitral award upheld; original judgment in favor of respondent sustained.
